items.markdown:
![Khao Soi: Northern Thai Curry Noodle Soup Recipe](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280322-1672-0139-0000-ccc9da5662d9:4)
Khao soi is a rich Northern Thai coconut curry noodle soup. Its distinct flavor comes from simmering a fragrant curry paste (made from `chilies, shallots, garlic, lemongrass, and fresh turmeric` ) with coconut milk, chicken stock, and warm spices, then serving it over soft egg noodles and topping it with crispy fried noodles.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kao-soi/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kao-soi/)[[2]](https://thai-foodie.com/thaifood/chicken-khao-soi-recipe-%E0%B8%82%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%8B%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A2/)

The Curry Paste & Base Aromatics

You can make a paste from scratch or use store-bought red/yellow curry paste blended with these fresh aromatics:[](https://www.feastingathome.com/thai-coconut-noodle-soup-khao-soi/) [[1]](https://www.feastingathome.com/thai-coconut-noodle-soup-khao-soi/)[[2]](https://www.seriouseats.com/khao-soi-gai-northern-thai-coconut-curry-noodle-soup-recipe-laksa)

- **Fresh Aromatics:** Shallots, garlic, ginger, fresh turmeric root (which gives the soup its iconic golden color), lemongrass, and cilantro roots/stems.[](https://www.seriouseats.com/khao-soi-gai-northern-thai-coconut-curry-noodle-soup-recipe-laksa) 
- **Dry Spices:** Mild dried red chilies (like guajillo or puya), coriander seeds, yellow curry powder, cardamom, and sometimes a touch of black cardamom.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kao-soi/) 
- **The Curry Broth:** Full-fat coconut milk and chicken stock.[](https://www.feastingathome.com/thai-coconut-noodle-soup-khao-soi/) 

Protein & Seasoning

- **Protein:** Chicken (drumsticks or boneless thighs) is traditional. (You can also substitute beef, shrimp, or crispy tofu).
- **Seasoning:** Fish sauce, soy sauce (regular and sometimes dark), and palm sugar (or brown sugar) to balance the sweet, salty, and savory flavors.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kao-soi/) [[1]](https://wanderingsinmykitchen.com/khao-soi-northern-thai-curry/)

The Noodles & Essential Garnishes The hallmark of khao soi is its texture, achieved with:[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kao-soi/) 

- **Noodles:** Flat wheat-based egg noodles (wonton noodles). Some are boiled to sit in the soup, and a handful are deep-fried to create a crispy topping.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kao-soi/) [[1]](https://www.facebook.com/HotThaiKitchen/videos/kao-soi-curry-noodle-soup-recipe-%E0%B8%82%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%8B%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A2-hot-thai-kitchen/869425567065627/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3eOEqeff18U&t=2)
- **Condiments & Toppings:** Freshly chopped cilantro, green onions, raw sliced shallots (or red onions), lime wedges, sour pickled mustard greens (to cut the richness), and fried chili flakes or chili oil.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kao-soi/)

expanded_element.title: Khao soi - Wikipedia
expanded_element.description: Northern Thai khao soi or khao soi Islam is closer to the present-day Burmese ohn no khao swè, being a soup-like dish made with a mix of deep-fried crispy egg noodles and boiled egg noodles, pickled mustard greens, shallots, lime, ground chillies fried in oil, and meat in a curry-like sauce containing coconut milk.
